from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/quic/sessions")

class TeardownRequest(BaseModel):
    session_id: str
    close_code: int = 0
    reason: str = "Client teardown"

@router.post("/close")
async def close_webtransport_session(
    payload: TeardownRequest,
    session_manager: WebTransportSessionManager = Depends(get_wt_session_manager),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    session = session_manager.get_session(payload.session_id)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="WebTransport session not found")

    session.close(code=payload.close_code, reason=payload.reason)
    return {"status": "terminated", "session_id": payload.session_id}
diagnosis: The WebTransport session teardown endpoint accepts a session_id and forcibly closes the underlying QUIC connection. Because it does not verify whether session.user_id matches current_user.id, any authenticated user can terminate active WebTransport sessions belonging to other tenants, disrupting live streams and collaborative editing sessions.
